summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with parse_shacl_path and SHACLPathError, and test/test_extras/test_shacl_extras.py with a parametrized valid/invalid test, a non-node input test, and a graph-unchanged test. The 42 tests in test_shacl_extras.py and test/test_path.py pass under the shared venv. mypy, ruff, black and isort are not installed in that venv, so the type-check and lint gates were not run; formatting was checked by hand for the 88-column limit only. Nothing was committed.
